units: Ex. R. s. 1, v. נָעַר II Nif.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> <he>משמרתו … בנַעֲרוּתוֹ</he> the Law guards him from all evil while he is young.
Gen. R. s. 84 (ref. to Gen. XXXVII, 2) שהיה עושה מעשה נ׳ he acted puerilely (was vain); a. fr.—Esp. maidenhood, the age or the legal status of a נַעֲרָה.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:2:10">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B00092"><he>בַּגְרוּת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 4a:21">Kidd. 4ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>סימני נ׳</he> the symptoms of maidenhood (puberty); a. fr.
